name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on flat bench, grip bar slightly wider than shoulders, lower to chest, press up.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degrees, grip bar slightly wider than shoulders, lower to upper chest, press up.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Set bench to decline, grip bar slightly wider than shoulders, lower to lower chest, press up.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on flat bench with dumbbells at chest level, press up and together, lower with control.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degrees, press dumbbells from chest level upward, lower with control.

name: Decline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set bench to decline, press dumbbells from chest level upward, lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Lie on bench, hold dumbbells above chest with slight bend in elbows, lower arms in arc, squeeze back up.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Set bench to incline, hold dumbbells above chest with slight elbow bend, lower in arc, squeeze up.

name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Stand between cable stacks, grab handles, step forward, bring hands together in arc at chest level.

name: Low Cable Fly
instructions: Set cables low, grab handles, step forward, bring hands up and together in arc.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Sit in machine, grip handles at chest level, press forward, return with control.

name: Pec Deck Machine
instructions: Sit in machine, place forearms against pads, squeeze arms together, return slowly.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Start in plank position, lower body until chest nearly touches floor, push back up.

name: Chest Dip
instructions: Lean forward on parallel bars, lower body until upper arms are parallel, press up.

name: Svend Press
instructions: Hold plate between palms at chest, press forward while squeezing, return to chest.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, grip bar outside knees, drive through heels, stand up keeping bar close.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
instructions: Hinge at hips, grip bar shoulder-width, pull to lower chest, squeeze shoulder blades, lower.

name: Pendlay Row
instructions: Hinge forward parallel to floor, pull bar explosively to lower chest from dead stop each rep.

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Row
instructions: Place one hand and knee on bench, row dumbbell to hip with other arm, squeeze at top.

name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
instructions: Hinge at hips holding dumbbells, pull both to lower ribs, squeeze shoulder blades together.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at machine, grip bar wide, pull down to upper chest, control the return.

name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Use V-bar or close-grip handle, pull to upper chest, squeeze lats, control return.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from bar with overhand grip, pull chin above bar, lower with control.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Hang from bar with underhand grip, pull chin above bar, lower with control.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit at cable row, grab handle, pull to lower chest, squeeze shoulder blades, return slowly.

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Straddle T-bar, grip handles, pull weight to chest, squeeze back, lower with control.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Set cable at face height with rope, pull toward face separating rope ends, squeeze rear delts.

name: Machine Row
instructions: Sit at machine, chest against pad, pull handles back, squeeze shoulder blades.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: Stand at cable, grip bar with straight arms, pull down to thighs in arc, return slowly.

name: Rack Pull
instructions: Set barbell at knee height in rack, grip and stand up, squeeze at top, lower to pins.

name: Hyperextension
instructions: Position on hyperextension bench, lower upper body, raise back to horizontal, squeeze glutes.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Bar on upper back, feet shoulder-width, squat until thighs are parallel, drive up through heels.

name: Barbell Front Squat
instructions: Bar on front delts, elbows high, squat deep keeping torso upright, drive up.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit in machine, feet shoulder-width on platform, lower until knees at 90 degrees, press up.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: Stand in hack squat machine, shoulders under pads, squat down and press up.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Sit in machine, pad on shins, extend legs fully, squeeze quads, lower with control.

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down, pad behind ankles, curl legs up, squeeze hamstrings, lower slowly.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Sit in machine, pad on back of ankles, curl legs down and back, squeeze, return.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold bar at hips, hinge forward keeping slight knee bend, lower until hamstring stretch, stand up.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold dumbbells at thighs, hinge forward with slight knee bend, lower to shins, stand up.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rear foot on bench, hold dumbbells, lower until front thigh is parallel, push up.

name: Dumbbell Lunge
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides, step forward, lower until both knees at 90 degrees, push back up.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Hold dumbbells, step forward into lunge, stand and step forward with other leg, continue.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold dumbbell at chest, squat deep keeping torso upright, drive through heels to stand.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on calf raise machine, rise onto toes, squeeze at top, lower with full stretch.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit at machine, knees under pad, raise heels, squeeze at top, lower with full stretch.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Upper back on bench, bar across hips, drive hips up squeezing glutes, lower with control.

name: Hip Abduction Machine
instructions: Sit in machine, press legs outward against pads, squeeze at end, return slowly.

name: Hip Adduction Machine
instructions: Sit in machine, squeeze legs inward against pads, squeeze at center, return slowly.

name: Smith Machine Squat
instructions: Bar on upper back in Smith machine, feet slightly forward, squat down and press up.

name: Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Wide stance, grip bar inside knees, drive through heels, stand tall, lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Step-Up
instructions: Hold dumbbells, step onto bench with one foot, drive up to stand on bench, step down.

name: Overhead Barbell Press
instructions: Bar at collar bones, grip slightly wider than shoulders, press overhead, lower to chin level.

name: Seated Barbell OHP
instructions: Sit on bench with back support, press bar from shoulders overhead, lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit or stand, hold dumbbells at shoulder height, press overhead, lower to shoulders.

name: Arnold Press
instructions: Start with palms facing you at chin, rotate palms outward as you press overhead, reverse on return.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at sides, raise arms out to sides until shoulder height, lower slowly.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand sideways to low cable, raise handle out to side to shoulder height, lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of thighs, raise one or both arms forward to shoulder height.

name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Bend forward at hips, raise dumbbells out to sides squeezing rear delts, lower slowly.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
instructions: Sit facing machine, grip handles, open arms in reverse fly motion, squeeze rear delts.

name: Barbell Upright Row
instructions: Grip bar narrow, pull up along body to chin, elbows high, lower with control.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Hold bar at thighs, shrug shoulders up toward ears, squeeze at top, lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides, shrug shoulders up toward ears, squeeze at top, lower slowly.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit at machine, grip handles at shoulder height, press overhead, lower with control.

name: Machine Lateral Raise
instructions: Sit in machine, pads on outer arms, raise arms to shoulder height, lower with control.

name: Landmine Press
instructions: Hold end of barbell at shoulder, press upward and forward, lower with control.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand holding barbell with underhand grip, curl to shoulders keeping elbows at sides, lower slowly.

name: EZ Bar Curl
instructions: Grip EZ bar on angled portions, curl to shoulders keeping elbows at sides, lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Stand or sit, curl dumbbells to shoulders with supinated grip, lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells with neutral grip, curl to shoulders keeping palms facing each other, lower slowly.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Sit on incline bench, arms hanging, curl dumbbells up, squeeze, lower with full stretch.

name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit, brace elbow on inner thigh, curl dumbbell to shoulder, squeeze, lower slowly.

name: Preacher Curl Machine
instructions: Sit at machine, arms on pad, curl handle up, squeeze biceps, lower with control.

name: Barbell Preacher Curl
instructions: Rest upper arms on preacher bench, curl bar up, squeeze at top, lower with control.

name: Cable Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand at low cable, curl handle to shoulders keeping elbows at sides, lower slowly.

name: Spider Curl
instructions: Lie chest down on incline bench, arms hanging, curl dumbbells up, squeeze, lower slowly.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Grip bar shoulder-width or narrower, lower to lower chest, press up focusing on triceps.

name: Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on bench, hold bar above chest, bend elbows to lower bar toward forehead, extend back up.

name: Cable Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Stand at high cable, grip bar or rope, push down until arms straight, return to 90 degrees.

name: Rope Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Stand at high cable with rope, push down splitting rope at bottom, squeeze, return slowly.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Hold dumbbell overhead with both hands, lower behind head bending elbows, extend back up.

name: Cable Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Face away from low cable, grip rope overhead, extend arms forward, return behind head.

name: Dumbbell Tricep Kickback
instructions: Bend forward, upper arm parallel to floor, extend forearm back, squeeze tricep, lower slowly.

name: Tricep Dip
instructions: Support on parallel bars, lower body keeping torso upright, press up focusing on triceps.

name: Diamond Push-Up
instructions: Push-up position with hands together forming diamond shape, lower and press up.

name: Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit, forearms on thighs with wrists over edge, curl bar up with wrists, lower slowly.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit, forearms on thighs palms down, extend wrists up, lower slowly.

name: Plank
instructions: Support on forearms and toes, keep body straight, hold position, engage core throughout.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Support on one forearm, stack feet, keep body straight from head to heels, hold.

name: Crunch
instructions: Lie on back, knees bent, curl shoulders off floor squeezing abs, lower slowly.

name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on back, alternate bringing elbow to opposite knee while extending other leg.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from bar, raise legs to parallel or higher, lower with control without swinging.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from bar, raise knees to chest, lower with control without swinging.

name: Cable Woodchop
instructions: Set cable high, grip handle, rotate torso pulling diagonally down across body, return slowly.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel at cable, hold rope behind head, crunch down squeezing abs, return slowly.

name: Ab Rollout
instructions: Kneel with ab wheel, roll forward extending body, pull back using core, maintain flat back.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit with knees bent and feet off floor, rotate torso side to side, optionally hold weight.

name: Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on back, hands under hips, raise straight legs to vertical, lower without touching floor.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on back, arms up, knees at 90, extend opposite arm and leg while keeping back flat.

name: Mountain Climber
instructions: Start in push-up position, alternate driving knees to chest quickly.

name: Pallof Press
instructions: Stand sideways to cable, hold handle at chest, press straight out resisting rotation, return.

name: Decline Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on decline bench, feet hooked, sit up fully contracting abs, lower with control.

name: Barbell Clean
instructions: From floor, explosively pull bar upward, catch in front rack position at shoulders.

name: Power Clean
instructions: From floor, explosively extend hips and pull bar, catch at shoulders without full squat.

name: Barbell Snatch
instructions: Wide grip, explosively pull bar from floor overhead in one motion, catch in squat position.

name: Barbell Thruster
instructions: Front squat down, drive up explosively pressing bar overhead in one fluid movement.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
instructions: Hold dumbbells at shoulders, squat down, drive up pressing dumbbells overhead.

name: Turkish Get-Up
instructions: Lie with weight overhead, stand up through series of movements keeping weight locked out.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Hinge at hips, swing weight between legs, explosively drive hips forward to swing to chest height.

name: Clean and Press
instructions: Clean bar to shoulders, then press overhead, lower to shoulders, return to floor.

name: Man Maker
instructions: Push-up, row each arm, jump feet in, clean to shoulders, press overhead.

name: Burpee
instructions: Squat down, kick feet back to push-up position, do push-up, jump feet in, jump up.

name: Battle Rope Slam
instructions: Hold rope ends, raise arms overhead, slam ropes down forcefully, repeat rapidly.

name: Farmer's Walk
instructions: Hold heavy dumbbells at sides, walk with upright posture for prescribed distance or time.

name: Dumbbell Snatch
instructions: Single dumbbell between legs, explosively drive hips and pull overhead in one motion.

name: Incline Cable Fly
instructions: Set bench incline between low cables, bring handles together above upper chest in arc.

name: Plate Loaded Chest Press
instructions: Sit at plate loaded machine, grip handles at chest level, press forward, return slowly.

name: Single-Arm Cable Fly
instructions: Stand at cable, single handle, bring arm across body in fly motion, squeeze chest.

name: Meadows Row
instructions: Stand perpendicular to landmine, grip end overhand, row to hip, squeeze lat.

name: Chest Supported Row
instructions: Lie chest down on incline bench, row dumbbells to sides, squeeze shoulder blades.

name: Inverted Row
instructions: Hang under bar, body straight, pull chest to bar, squeeze back, lower with control.

name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
instructions: Use single handle on cable, pull down to side of chest, squeeze lat, return slowly.

name: Good Morning
instructions: Bar on upper back, hinge at hips keeping slight knee bend, lower until torso near parallel, stand.

name: Deficit Deadlift
instructions: Stand on small platform, deadlift from deeper starting position for extra range of motion.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
instructions: Stand inside trap bar, grip handles, drive through heels to stand, lower with control.

name: Pistol Squat
instructions: Stand on one leg, extend other leg forward, squat down on single leg, stand back up.

name: Glute-Ham Raise
instructions: Kneel at GHD machine, lower torso forward controlling with hamstrings, pull back up.

name: Cable Pull-Through
instructions: Face away from low cable, hinge at hips, pull rope through legs standing tall, squeeze glutes.

name: Reverse Lunge
instructions: Hold dumbbells, step backward into lunge, lower until both knees at 90 degrees, push back.

name: Single-Leg Press
instructions: One foot on leg press platform, press through heel, lower with control.

name: Sissy Squat
instructions: Hold support, lean back bending knees forward, lower until thighs stretch fully, push up.

name: Donkey Calf Raise
instructions: Bend at waist, pad on lower back, rise onto toes, squeeze calves, lower slowly.

name: Machine Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit in hip thrust machine, drive hips up squeezing glutes, lower with control.

name: Lu Raise
instructions: Front raise to shoulder height, rotate arms out to lateral raise position, lower slowly.

name: Cable Face Pull
instructions: Set cable at face height with rope, pull toward face, externally rotate at end, return.

name: Behind the Neck Press
instructions: Bar behind neck on traps, press overhead, lower to behind neck with control. Requires mobility.

name: Plate Front Raise
instructions: Hold weight plate with both hands, raise to shoulder height, lower with control.

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Cross cables at low position, pull handles outward and back, squeeze rear delts.

name: Prone Y Raise
instructions: Lie face down on incline bench, raise arms in Y shape, squeeze upper back, lower slowly.

name: Reverse Curl
instructions: Hold bar with overhand grip, curl to shoulders keeping elbows fixed, lower slowly.

name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
instructions: Curl dumbbell across body toward opposite shoulder with neutral grip, lower slowly.

name: Cable Hammer Curl
instructions: Use rope on low cable, curl with neutral grip, squeeze at top, lower slowly.

name: Bayesian Curl
instructions: Stand facing away from low cable, arm behind body, curl handle forward, squeeze, lower.

name: Single-Arm Overhead Extension
instructions: Hold single dumbbell overhead, lower behind head bending elbow, extend back up.

name: JM Press
instructions: Hybrid of close-grip press and skull crusher, lower bar to chin level, press up.

name: Bench Dip
instructions: Hands on bench behind you, lower body bending elbows, press back up.

name: Tate Press
instructions: Lie on bench, hold dumbbells with elbows out, lower to chest, extend back up.

name: V-Up
instructions: Lie flat, simultaneously raise legs and torso to touch toes, forming V shape.

name: Flutter Kick
instructions: Lie on back, legs extended, alternate kicking legs up and down in small range.

name: Toe Touch
instructions: Lie on back with legs vertical, reach hands up to touch toes, lower shoulders down.

name: Dragon Flag
instructions: Lie on bench, grip behind head, raise body keeping straight line, lower with control.

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
instructions: Lie on bench under Smith machine, lower bar to chest, press up along guided path.

name: Single-Arm Cable Row
instructions: Sit at cable, grip single handle, pull to side, squeeze back, return slowly.

name: Barbell Pullover
instructions: Lie on bench, hold bar overhead, lower behind head with slight elbow bend, pull back over chest.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Lie across bench, hold dumbbell overhead, lower behind head with slight elbow bend, pull back.

name: Neutral Grip Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from parallel handles with palms facing each other, pull chin above handles, lower slowly.

name: Box Squat
instructions: Squat to box behind you, pause briefly, drive up explosively. Teaches proper depth.

name: Front Foot Elevated Split Squat
instructions: Front foot on small platform, hold dumbbells, lunge down for deeper range, push up.

name: Lateral Lunge
instructions: Step wide to side, bend stepping leg keeping other straight, push back to start.

name: Belt Squat
instructions: Attach belt to weight, stand on platforms, squat down and up without spinal loading.

name: Pendulum Squat
instructions: Stand in pendulum machine, shoulders under pads, squat through arc motion, press up.

name: Nordic Curl
instructions: Kneel with feet anchored, lower torso forward controlling with hamstrings, push off floor to return.

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
instructions: Place toes on bottom of leg press platform, press through toes extending ankles, lower slowly.

name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
instructions: Upper back on bench, one foot on floor, drive hips up on single leg, squeeze glute.

name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
instructions: Bar on shoulders in Smith machine, toes on block, rise and lower through full range.

name: Overhead Squat
instructions: Hold barbell overhead with wide grip, squat deep keeping bar directly over midfoot.

name: Hang Clean
instructions: Start from hang position at knees, explosively extend hips, catch bar at shoulders.

name: Push Press
instructions: Bar at shoulders, slight knee dip, explosively drive bar overhead using leg drive.

name: Wall Ball
instructions: Hold medicine ball at chest, squat down, drive up throwing ball to target on wall, catch.

name: Sled Push
instructions: Grip sled handles, lean forward, drive through legs pushing sled across floor.

name: Bear Crawl
instructions: On hands and toes, knees hovering, crawl forward moving opposite hand and foot together.

name: Floor Press
instructions: Lie on floor, press bar from chest lockout, elbows touch floor at bottom of each rep.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
instructions: Lie on floor with dumbbells, press up from floor, elbows touch floor at bottom.

name: Close-Grip Push-Up
instructions: Push-up with hands close together, lower and press up focusing on inner chest and triceps.

name: Weighted Pull-Up
instructions: Attach weight via belt, perform pull-up with added load, lower with control.

name: Weighted Dip
instructions: Attach weight via belt, dip down until upper arms parallel, press up.

name: Zercher Squat
instructions: Hold bar in crook of elbows, squat deep, drive up keeping torso upright.

name: Pause Squat
instructions: Squat to bottom position, pause for 2-3 seconds, drive up explosively.

name: Safety Bar Squat
instructions: Use safety squat bar, grip handles, squat and drive up. Easier on shoulders.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand on one leg, hinge forward extending other leg back, lower dumbbell, return to standing.

name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
instructions: Hold bar, hinge forward with legs nearly straight, lower until hamstring stretch, stand up.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
instructions: Attach ankle cuff to low cable, kick leg straight back, squeeze glute, return slowly.

name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit under Smith machine, press bar overhead along guided path, lower to chin.

name: Scott Press
instructions: Start with palms facing you, press up while rotating and leaning slightly outward.

name: Cable Upright Row
instructions: Grip bar at low cable, pull up along body to chin with elbows high, lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Clean
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides, hinge and explosively clean to shoulders, stand tall.

name: Muscle-Up
instructions: Hang from bar, pull up explosively, transition over bar and press to support position.

name: Sandbag Clean and Press
instructions: Grip sandbag on floor, clean to shoulders, press overhead, lower to floor.

name: Landmine Squat
instructions: Hold end of barbell at chest, squat deep, drive up. Good for beginners learning squat pattern.

name: Landmine Row
instructions: Straddle barbell in landmine, grip end, row to chest, squeeze back, lower.

name: Zottman Curl
instructions: Curl up with supinated grip, rotate to pronated at top, lower with overhand grip.

name: Behind-the-Back Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand next to low cable, cable behind body, raise arm out to side, lower slowly.

name: Incline Barbell Row
instructions: Lie face down on incline bench, row barbell up, squeeze shoulder blades, lower.

name: Reverse-Grip Bent-Over Row
instructions: Hinge at hips, underhand grip on bar, row to lower abs, squeeze, lower slowly.

name: Seated Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Sit on bench, curl dumbbells alternating or together, squeeze at top, lower slowly.

name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Grip bar extra wide, pull down to upper chest, squeeze outer lats, return slowly.

name: Reverse-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Grip bar underhand shoulder-width, pull down to upper chest, squeeze lats, return.

name: EZ Bar Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on bench with EZ bar, lower to forehead bending elbows, extend back up. Easier on wrists.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on back, feet flat, drive hips up squeezing glutes, hold at top, lower slowly.

name: Sumo Squat
instructions: Wide stance, toes out, hold dumbbell between legs, squat down and up.

name: Incline Hammer Curl
instructions: Sit on incline bench, arms hanging, curl with neutral grip, squeeze, lower with stretch.

name: Machine Curl
instructions: Sit at bicep curl machine, grip handle, curl up, squeeze, lower with control.

name: Tricep Extension Machine
instructions: Sit at machine, grip handles, extend arms downward, squeeze triceps, return slowly.

name: Treadmill Run
instructions: Set desired speed and incline. Maintain good posture, land midfoot, keep a steady pace.

name: Stationary Bike
instructions: Adjust seat height, maintain steady cadence, keep core engaged throughout.

name: Elliptical
instructions: Stand upright, grip handles, push and pull with arms while driving legs in smooth elliptical motion.

name: Rowing Machine
instructions: Drive with legs first, then lean back slightly and pull handle to lower chest. Return in reverse order.

name: Stair Climber
instructions: Step at a steady pace, avoid leaning on handrails, keep upright posture.

name: Jump Rope
instructions: Jump with slight bounce on balls of feet, rotate rope with wrists, keep elbows close to body.

name: Outdoor Run
instructions: Maintain steady pace, land midfoot, keep arms relaxed at 90 degrees.

name: Cycling
instructions: Maintain cadence of 70-90 RPM, keep back straight, shift gears to manage intensity.

name: Swimming
instructions: Choose stroke style, maintain rhythmic breathing, focus on form and consistent pace.

name: HIIT Sprints
instructions: Alternate between 20-30 second all-out sprints and 60-90 second recovery periods.

name: Battle Ropes
instructions: Grip rope ends, create alternating or simultaneous waves with explosive arm movements.

name: Walking
instructions: Walk at a brisk pace, swing arms naturally, maintain upright posture.
